children: China natural gas and clean energy provider's HY2026 revenue fell yr/yr amid weaker domestic demand
Company attributed revenue decline to higher LNG prices and subdued industrial demand
Board did not recommend interim dividend for HY2026
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or forecasts for the current quarter or full year in the press release
WEAKER INDUSTRIAL DEMAND - Co said subdued industrial demand and cost constraints on end-user energy use contributed to revenue decline
HIGHER LNG PRICES - Co said rising LNG prices narrowed its advantage over pipeline gas and other clean energy sources, impacting demand
SEASONALITY AND WEATHER - Co said higher overall temperatures during the heating season led to a decline in seasonal peak demand for city gas
